seo.paid: Fast, trustworthy landing pages lower cost per click and lift Quality Score.
seo.pr: A clear About page, schema and newsroom give journalists and AI tools facts to cite.
seo.email: Content that ranks becomes the newsletter and nurture library.

pr.paid: Press mentions make ad copy and landing pages more credible.
pr.seo: Earned coverage and links build the authority search and AI answers reward.

email.paid: Welcome and cart flows turn paid clicks into revenue after the first visit.
